package domain

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type SummaryFilter struct {
	UserID   uuid.UUID
	CourseID *uuid.UUID
	LessonID *uuid.UUID
	TaskID   *uuid.UUID
	From     *time.Time
	To       *time.Time
}

type TaskSummary struct {
	TaskID                uuid.UUID
	StartedAt             *time.Time
	EndedAt               *time.Time
	SessionCount          int
	TypingEvents          int
	TotalDurationSeconds  float64
	ReadingDurationSecond float64
	SolvingDurationSecond float64
	AvgDurationSeconds    float64
}

type SummaryRepository interface {
	GetTaskSummary(ctx context.Context, filter SummaryFilter) (*TaskSummary, error)
	ListTaskSummaries(ctx context.Context, filter SummaryFilter, limit, offset int) ([]TaskSummary, error)
}
